dialogues.jp: 「屋上でお昼を食べるのも、久しぶりだな」
dialogues.en: "It's been a while since I had lunch on the rooftop."
dialogues.text: "It's been a while since I had lunch on the rooftop."

dialogues.jp:
暖かな春の光を浴びつつ、テーブルの前に座る。
テーブルの上には相変わらず鍋が置かれていた。
dialogues.en:
I sat in front of the table as I felt the warm sunlight of
spring. There was the same old hot pot on the table.
dialogues.text:
I sat in front of the table as I felt the warm sunlight of
spring. There was the same old hot pot on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。朝倉くんの足がダメな間は、来ていま
　せんでしたから」
dialogues.en:
"You're right. We didn't come here while your leg was
injured."
dialogues.text:
"You're right. We didn't come here while your leg was
injured."

dialogues.jp: 楽しげに話す萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai spoke delightfully.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai spoke delightfully.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱりお日様のもとで食べるのが、一番美
　味しいです」
dialogues.en: "Food tastes delicious under the sunlight."
dialogues.text: "Food tastes delicious under the sunlight."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ですね……でも、そろそろ鍋はやめません？
　だいぶ暖かくなってきたし」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, it does...... but Moe-sempai? I think we should stop
eating hot pots now...... It's been a lot warmer lately."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, it does...... but Moe-sempai? I think we should stop
eating hot pots now...... It's been a lot warmer lately."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね……もう春ですし。分かりました。
　これからはお弁当を作ってきますね」
dialogues.en:
"I guess you're right...... it's spring now. I'll start
bringing a lunch box then."
dialogues.text:
"I guess you're right...... it's spring now. I'll start
bringing a lunch box then."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それはいいな」
dialogues.en: "That sounds good."
dialogues.text: "That sounds good."

dialogues.jp: 桜の木の下で食べれば、まさに花見気分。
dialogues.en: It would be nice to eat under the cherry blossom tree.
dialogues.text: It would be nice to eat under the cherry blossom tree.

dialogues.jp:
もっともここは屋上であって、桜の木の下じゃ
ないけど。
dialogues.en: Well, there are no trees here on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: Well, there are no trees here on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: （それにしても、人いないな……）
dialogues.en: (Anyway, it's so empty here......)
dialogues.text: (Anyway, it's so empty here......)

dialogues.jp:
春だというのに、屋上には俺達の他に誰も出て
きていない。ゴミひとつ散らかってないあたり
が、その証拠だろう。
dialogues.en:
It's spring time now, but there's no one else but us on the
rooftop. There wasn't even any garbage on the floor here.
dialogues.text:
It's spring time now, but there's no one else but us on the
rooftop. There wasn't even any garbage on the floor here.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、ここは教員棟だし。うじゃうじゃ人がい
たらそっちのほうが問題か。
dialogues.en:
Well, this is the teacher's building. It's better like this,
compared to having lots of people out here.
dialogues.text:
Well, this is the teacher's building. It's better like this,
compared to having lots of people out here.

dialogues.jp: 「そう言えば、眞子は？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, where's Mako?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, where's Mako?"

dialogues.jp: 昼はいつも一緒にいたような気がするけど。
dialogues.en: I thought she always came with us for lunch.
dialogues.text: I thought she always came with us for lunch.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ちゃんはクラスの人たちと食堂です」
dialogues.en: "Mako-chan went to the cafeteria with her friends."
dialogues.text: "Mako-chan went to the cafeteria with her friends."

dialogues.jp: にこやかに答える萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She replied with a smile.
dialogues.text: She replied with a smile.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、クラス変えもあったし、新しい付き合い
でも出来たか？
dialogues.en: She might have found a new friend in her new class.
dialogues.text: She might have found a new friend in her new class.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Here you go, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Here you go, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
おでんののった皿を受け取る。立ち昇る湯気は、
すぐに周りの空気に溶け込み消えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
She passed me a plate of simmered fish cake. The rising
steam quickly disappeared into the air.
dialogues.text:
She passed me a plate of simmered fish cake. The rising
steam quickly disappeared into the air.

dialogues.jp: （それだけ暖かくなったと言うことか）
dialogues.en: (It's getting pretty warm outside.)
dialogues.text: (It's getting pretty warm outside.)

dialogues.jp:
見上げれば、前よりも真上にくるようになった
太陽が、ぽかぽかと照っていた。
dialogues.en: When I looked up, the sun was shining right above me.
dialogues.text: When I looked up, the sun was shining right above me.

dialogues.jp: ◆鍋は終わり◆
dialogues.en: ◆No more hot pot◆
dialogues.text: ◆No more hot pot◆

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりに、屋上で食事を一緒にした。
dialogues.en: We had lunch on the rooftop for the first time in a while.
dialogues.text: We had lunch on the rooftop for the first time in a while.

dialogues.jp: けど、もう暑いし、そろそろ鍋はやめたいかな。
dialogues.en:
However, it's getting too warm, so I don't want hot pot
anymore.
dialogues.text:
However, it's getting too warm, so I don't want hot pot
anymore.
